name: GastDa Belegungskalender
author: gastda

sections.description:
GastDa combines the bookings from Airbnb, Booking.com and other portals with your own bookings in one calendar. This plugin shows that calendar on your website without you having to paste any HTML.

  • Dedicated “GastDa” admin menu with an overview, open booking requests and bookings
  • Accept or decline booking requests in WordPress, GastDa notifies the guest by email
  • Counter for open requests on the menu item and a widget on the WordPress dashboard
  • “GastDa-Belegungskalender” block with a property picker
  • Shortcode [gastda objekt="12"] for Elementor, Divi, the classic editor and text widgets
  • Several calendars on one page, for example to show multiple apartments
  • Two-click solution: the calendar is only loaded from GastDa after the visitor agrees
  • Suggested text for your privacy policy (Settings → Privacy → Policy Guide)
  • Connection check: the plugin shows which property belongs to the embed code you pasted

Visitors only see whether a day is free, requested or booked. Guest data, prices and the source of a booking are never shown.

You need a GastDa account (free for up to three properties). The GastDa user interface is currently available in German only.

External services

This plugin connects to GastDa (https://gastda.de), the service in which you manage your bookings.

  • On your website, the visitor’s browser loads widget.js and the availability (free, requested, booked) from GastDa. This transmits the visitor’s IP address to GastDa; with the two-click solution enabled, only after the visitor has agreed. If the visitor sends a booking request, the data they enter is sent to GastDa.
  • Below the calendar, GastDa shows the note “Kalender von GastDa” (calendar by GastDa) with a logo and a link to gastda.de. It is rendered by the GastDa service, not by this plugin, and can be turned off per property in a paid GastDa plan.
  • In the WordPress admin, your website’s server uses your access key to fetch your account, properties, bookings and booking requests from GastDa, and sends your decisions on booking requests to GastDa.

Privacy policy: https://gastda.de/datenschutz
Legal notice: https://gastda.de/impressum
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. In GastDa, go to Einstellungen → WordPress verbinden (Settings → Connect WordPress) and create an access key.
  3. In WordPress, go to GastDa → Einstellungen (Settings), paste the key and choose your default property.
  4. Add the “GastDa-Belegungskalender” block or the shortcode [gastda] to a page.

To only show the calendar you do not need an access key: in GastDa, open the property, copy the embed code under “Widget und Objektseite” (widget and property page) and paste it into the plugin settings.
sections.faq:
How do I show a property other than the default one?

In the block, pick the property in the sidebar. With the shortcode, use [gastda objekt="12"]; you will find the number under GastDa → Übersicht (Overview). Without a connected account, [gastda token="TOKEN"] works as well.

How many months does the calendar show?

12 by default, adjustable from 1 to 24: [gastda months="6"].

I use Borlabs Cookie, Complianz or another consent manager.

Have your consent manager call window.GastDa.load() after consent is given, or dispatch the gastda:consent event on document. To turn off the two-click solution for a single page, use [gastda consent="no"].

Who can see booking requests and bookings?

Only administrators by default. Guest data is not stored in WordPress; it is loaded live from GastDa on every page view. Developers can change the required capability with the gastda_capability filter.

What if my website gets hacked?

Revoke the access key in GastDa under Einstellungen → WordPress verbinden (Settings → Connect WordPress). It stops working immediately.
